<b>Spit Squits</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are dexterous [[Squits]] adapted to the toxic environment of the [[Putrified Ducts]] and able to spit gobs of sizzling bile.<ref>Spit Squit [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Hovering pest with a hollowed proboscis able to spit gobs of sizzling bile. To subsist on the sickly water in this fetid environment it spits out the most toxic elements."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Spit Squits are initially found clinging to walls. Upon seeing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], they take flight and perform 2-3 short dashes through the air in random directions, maintaining distance from Hornet. At the same time as the last dash starts, the Spit Squit spits three arching projectiles in a burst in a cone to its left or right.

Because they cannot fire projectiles directly upwards or downwards, they can be more safely attacked from above or below. Alternatively, [[Cross Stitch]] can be used on the projectiles to secure an easy kill.

Spit Squits can also be killed by luring them into a [[Barnak]], though this does not contribute to the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]].

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Spit Squits have their health doubled. They gain one of the following [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]]: Void Blades, Void Tendrils, or Void Blobs.

They also lash out into a large circle of Void Blades a short time after being eaten by Barnaks, incapacitating them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Survive in smog...
* Choke on bile...
* Feed... or starve...
* Resist the rot...
}}

== Location ==
Spit Squits can be found in the [[Putrified Ducts]].
